mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS visitId, f.patient_basic_info_id AS patientId, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS visitDate, f.follow_up_date AS originalFollowUpDate, f.followUpDate AS originalCamelDate, f.doctor_id AS doctorId, u.name AS doctorName, f.research_type AS researchType, f.last_follow_up_id AS lastFollowUpId, f.bsbq, f.fzjc, f.bqpg, f.zyzd, f.zlfa, f.blsj, f.bblsj FROM patient_follow_up_history f LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = f.doctor_id WHERE f.id = #{visitId} AND f.research_type IN () AND f.patient_basic_info_id IN (SELECT r.patient_id FROM patient_relation_doctor r WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} AND r.research_type IN ())

SELECT f.id FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = #{patientId} AND f.research_type IN () ORDER BY COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate) IS NULL, COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate), f.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE patient_follow_up_history SET last_follow_up_id = #{prevVisitId} WHERE last_follow_up_id = #{visitId}

UPDATE patient_basic_info p JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) AS last FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = #{patientId}) v SET p.follow_up_count = v.cnt, p.last_follow_up_date = v.last, p.lastFollowUpDate = v.last WHERE p.id = #{patientId}

UPDATE patient_relation_doctor r JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, MIN(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) AS first, MAX(COALESCE(f.follow_up_date, f.followUpDate)) AS last FROM patient_follow_up_history f WHERE f.patient_basic_info_id = #{patientId} AND f.doctor_id = #{visitDoctorId} AND f.research_type = #{researchType}) v SET r.follow_count = v.cnt, r.first_follow_up_date = v.first, r.last_follow_up_date = v.last WHERE r.patient_id = #{patientId} AND r.doctor_id = #{visitDoctorId} AND r.research_type = #{researchType}

UPDATE patient_follow_up_history
bsbq = #{bsbq}, fzjc = #{fzjc}, bqpg = #{bqpg}, zyzd = #{zyzd}, zlfa = #{zlfa}, blsj = #{blsj}, bblsj = #{bblsj}, follow_up_date = #{visitDate}, followUpDate = #{visitDate},
WHERE id = #{visitId}
AND (follow_up_date <=> #{originalFollowUpDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AND (followUpDate <=> #{originalCamelDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
AND (BINARY bsbq <=> BINARY #{originals.bsbq,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}) AND (BINARY fzjc <=> BINARY #{originals.fzjc,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}) AND (BINARY bqpg <=> BINARY #{originals.bqpg,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}) AND (BINARY zyzd <=> BINARY #{originals.zyzd,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}) AND (BINARY zlfa <=> BINARY #{originals.zlfa,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}) AND (BINARY blsj <=> BINARY #{originals.blsj,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}) AND (BINARY bblsj <=> BINARY #{originals.bblsj,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR})
